snippet.title: SALAMANDER III (EN, ESRB) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
- SALAMANDER III (EN, ESRB) | KONAMI -

Thanks to the brave efforts of crown prince Lord British and the hero of the Gradius Army, peace was restored to the watery planet known as Latis.
However, that peace was short-lived as the seemingly defeated Salamander Force regained its strength and set out to conquer Latis once more.

Meanwhile, the Gradius Army found itself struggling against the Bacterian super weapon known as Dark Force, as the evil empire sought to spread its influence to the far reaches of the galaxy.

©Konami Digital Entertainment
